games.title: Polyvoid
games.summary: Circle neon bosses that change shape and fire wide lasers, and survive their bullets. Three levels on the ring: the Hollow Square (it splits in four, then grows two firing orbs), the Hex Warden, or the Gauntlet - both, back to back. Your laser fires by itself and follows you; graze the shots to raise the multiplier and power it up, dash through the gaps.
games.controls: Circle: A D, arrows, the mouse, or hold the left or right half of the screen. Choose a level: circle to it on the ring, then J, click or tap (or keys 1 2 3). Dash: Space, right click or the DASH zone. Pause: Esc. Menu: M.
games.by: A Polynite interactive demo - every shape, shot, rule and HUD is scene data, made through MCP.

games.title: Door & Key
games.summary: Three keys, three locked doors, one exit. Each door is the same component with its own state; the hero is a physics body stopped by walls.
games.controls: Move: WASD or arrows, or the left stick on touch.
games.by: A feasibility test: built by an LLM from the MCP catalog alone.

games.title: Platformer
games.summary: Run and jump on physics bodies, ride a moving platform, avoid the lava, reach the goal. Three lives.
games.controls: A D to run, W or Space to jump, or the touch zones.
games.by: A feasibility test: built by an LLM from the MCP catalog alone.

games.title: Lights Out
games.summary: A 5x5 grid: a press toggles a cell and its neighbours. Turn them all off. Twenty-five instances of one component; a seeded start that can be solved.
games.controls: Arrows and Space, or tap a cell.
games.by: A feasibility test: built by an LLM from the MCP catalog alone.

games.title: Waves
games.summary: Enemies come in growing waves from a prepared pool; survive five. Fourteen instances of one component, each with its own life.
games.controls: Move: WASD or arrows. Fire: hold Space. Restart: R or Enter.
games.by: A feasibility test: built by an LLM in the browser, from the MCP catalog alone.

games.title: Small RPG
games.summary: Two rooms, a shop, a bag, a quest and turn-based fights. Items, enemies, loot and levels all come from data tables.
games.controls: Move: WASD. Act: E. Items: 1-4. Sell or flee: X. Restart: R.
games.by: A feasibility test: built by an LLM in the browser, from the MCP catalog alone.
